blocks.zh: Section I–II: 導論與 CMC 變更法規路徑
blocks.en: Section I–II: Introduction and Regulatory Pathways for CMC Changes

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解本 Guidance 的適用範圍：僅限玻璃瓶 (glass vials) 和瓶塞 (stoppers) 的 Container Closure System (CCS) 變更
blocks.en: Understand the scope of this guidance: it covers only changes to the container closure system (CCS) for glass vials and stoppers

blocks.zh: 掌握 FDA 對核准後 CMC 變更的三層通報機制：Prior Approval Supplement (PAS)、CBE-30、Annual Report
blocks.en: Master FDA's three-tier reporting framework for post-approval CMC changes: Prior Approval Supplement (PAS), CBE-30, and Annual Report

blocks.zh: 了解風險導向 (risk-based) 的法規評估原則及其與 ICH Q9(R1)、ICH Q12 的連結
blocks.en: Understand the risk-based principles for regulatory assessment and how they link to ICH Q9(R1) and ICH Q12

blocks.zh: 認識 Drug Master File (DMF) 在 CCS 變更中的角色與限制
blocks.en: Recognize the role and limitations of the Drug Master File (DMF) in CCS changes

blocks.zh: 理解 CDMO 在供應商變更管理中的法規責任與策略意義
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory responsibilities and strategic significance of a CDMO's supplier change management

blocks.zh: I. Introduction 導論
blocks.en: I. Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Container Closure System (CCS, 容器密封系統)：CCS 是藥品與外界之間的最後一道屏障，由玻璃瓶 (glass vial)、瓶塞 (stopper)、鋁蓋 (aluminum seal) 等組成。CCS 的功能包括：(1) 維持無菌性 (sterility)、(2) 保護藥品免受光、氧氣及水分影響、(3) 與藥品配方不產生有害交互作用。
blocks.en: Container Closure System (CCS): The CCS is the last barrier between the drug product and the outside environment. It consists of the glass vial, stopper, aluminum seal, and so on. Its functions include: (1) maintaining sterility, (2) protecting the drug product from light, oxygen, and moisture, and (3) not interacting harmfully with the drug formulation.

blocks.zh: Reporting Categories (通報類別)：FDA 對核准後變更的通報分為三級：
blocks.en: Reporting Categories: FDA classifies post-approval change reporting into three levels:

blocks.zh: PAS (Prior Approval Supplement)：需 FDA 核准後才能實施，用於高風險變更
blocks.en: PAS (Prior Approval Supplement): Requires FDA approval before implementation; used for high-risk changes

blocks.zh: CBE-30 (Changes Being Effected in 30 Days)：提交後 30 天即可實施
blocks.en: CBE-30 (Changes Being Effected in 30 Days): May be implemented 30 days after submission

blocks.zh: Annual Report (年度報告)：實施後於年度報告中通知，用於低風險變更
blocks.en: Annual Report: Reported in the annual report after implementation; used for low-risk changes

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 CCS 想像成餐廳的餐具選擇 (restaurant dinnerware selection)。高級餐廳（注射劑藥廠）對餐具（CCS）的要求極為嚴格——不僅要乾淨，還要確保不會與食物產生化學反應、不會釋出有害物質。如果餐廳要換一套新餐具（變更 CCS 供應商），你不能只看外觀一樣就直接用，必須先測試新餐具在各種溫度、酸鹼度下是否安全。這就是為什麼 FDA 要求系統性的變更評估。
blocks.en: Think of the CCS as choosing dinnerware for a restaurant. A high-end restaurant (the injectable drug manufacturer) is extremely strict about its dinnerware (the CCS): it must be clean, must not react chemically with the food, and must not release harmful substances. If the restaurant wants to switch to a new set of dinnerware (change the CCS supplier), you cannot simply use it because it looks the same; you must first test whether the new dinnerware is safe at various temperatures and pH levels. This is why FDA requires a systematic change assessment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: COVID-19 的催化效應：這份 2024 年正式版 Guidance 起源於 2021 年 COVID-19 緊急期間的臨時指引。疫情期間全球玻璃瓶短缺（特別是 Type I borosilicate 玻璃），迫使藥廠緊急尋找替代供應商。FDA 因此發布臨時指引加速 CCS 變更審查。疫情結束後，FDA 認為這些建議具有長期適用性，因此正式化為這份 Guidance。
blocks.en: The COVID-19 catalyst: This final 2024 guidance originated from interim guidance issued during the 2021 COVID-19 emergency. During the pandemic, a global glass vial shortage (especially of Type I borosilicate glass) forced drug manufacturers to urgently find alternative suppliers, so FDA issued interim guidance to speed up review of CCS changes. After the pandemic, FDA concluded that these recommendations had long-term applicability and formalized them in this guidance.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍限定：本 Guidance 僅適用於玻璃瓶和瓶塞。不包含 pre-filled syringes、cartridges、plastic containers 等其他 CCS 類型。
blocks.en: Limited scope: This guidance applies only to glass vials and stoppers. It does not cover other CCS types such as pre-filled syringes, cartridges, or plastic containers.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：作為臨床期無菌充填代工廠 (CDMO)，你的客戶持有 NDA/BLA，而你是充填製造場地。當客戶的玻璃瓶供應商要求變更（如更換製造廠址），客戶必須評估此變更的通報類別並提交 supplement。你作為 CDMO 的角色是提供製程驗證數據（如 CCIT、media fill 數據）來支持客戶的申請。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: As a clinical-stage sterile fill-finish CDMO, your client holds the NDA/BLA and you are the filling site. When the client's glass vial supplier requests a change (such as moving to a different manufacturing site), the client must assess the reporting category for the change and submit a supplement. Your role as the CDMO is to provide process validation data (such as CCIT and media fill data) to support the client's application.

blocks.zh: Dual Sourcing 策略：疫情教訓使得許多公司開始建立 CCS 的雙供應商策略。本 Guidance 提供了清晰的法規路徑，讓藥廠可以預先規劃第二供應商的核准流程。
blocks.en: Dual sourcing strategy: The lessons of the pandemic led many companies to adopt a dual-supplier strategy for the CCS. This guidance provides a clear regulatory pathway, allowing drug manufacturers to plan the approval process for a second supplier in advance.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 選擇將 COVID-19 臨時指引正式化？這反映了哪些長期的供應鏈風險考量？
blocks.en: Why did FDA choose to formalize the COVID-19 interim guidance? What long-term supply chain risk considerations does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 本 Guidance 僅適用於 glass vials 和 stoppers，如果 CDMO 客戶想變更 pre-filled syringe 的組件，應參考哪些其他 FDA 指引？
blocks.en: This guidance applies only to glass vials and stoppers. If a CDMO client wants to change a component of a pre-filled syringe, which other FDA guidances should be consulted?

blocks.zh: NDA、BLA 和 ANDA 持有者在 CCS 變更中的法規責任有何不同？為什麼生物製品 (BLA) 的要求通常更嚴格？
blocks.en: How do the regulatory responsibilities of NDA, BLA, and ANDA holders differ for CCS changes? Why are requirements for biologics (BLA) generally stricter?

blocks.zh: II. Regulatory Approaches to CMC Changes 法規變更途徑
blocks.en: II. Regulatory Approaches to CMC Changes

blocks.zh: 三級通報機制就像房屋裝修的審批程序：
blocks.en: The three-tier reporting framework is like the approval process for a home renovation:

blocks.zh: PAS = 結構變更（如拆牆）：必須先取得建築許可才能開工，因為可能影響結構安全
blocks.en: PAS = structural change (such as removing a wall): You must obtain a building permit before starting work, because the change may affect structural safety

blocks.zh: CBE-30 = 水電變更（如移動插座）：先通知主管機關，30 天內沒有異議就可以動工
blocks.en: CBE-30 = plumbing or electrical change (such as moving an outlet): Notify the authority first; if there is no objection within 30 days, work can begin

blocks.zh: Annual Report = 油漆換色：不影響安全，做完之後在年度維護報告中記錄即可
blocks.en: Annual Report = repainting: It does not affect safety, so it is enough to record it in the annual maintenance report after the work is done

blocks.zh: 從藥品角度：換一種全新材質的玻璃瓶（PAS）vs 同供應商不同廠址（AR），風險截然不同。
blocks.en: From the drug product perspective: switching to a glass vial made of an entirely new material (PAS) versus moving the same supplier to a different site (AR) carries very different risk.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9(R1) + Q12 的核心角色：FDA 明確建議使用 ICH Q9(R1) 的品質風險管理 (Quality Risk Management) 原則和 ICH Q12 的產品生命週期管理工具（如 Established Conditions、PACMPs）。這意味著，如果藥廠能展示充分的風險評估和緩解策略，FDA 可能同意降低通報類別（例如從 PAS 降到 CBE-30）。
blocks.en: The core role of ICH Q9(R1) and Q12: FDA explicitly recommends using the Quality Risk Management principles of ICH Q9(R1) and the product lifecycle management tools of ICH Q12 (such as Established Conditions and PACMPs). This means that if a manufacturer can demonstrate adequate risk assessment and mitigation strategies, FDA may agree to a lower reporting category (for example, from PAS down to CBE-30).

blocks.zh: CCS 相容性的多維度評估：CCS 的適用性不只看容器本身，還要考慮：
blocks.en: Multidimensional assessment of CCS compatibility: The suitability of a CCS depends not only on the container itself; the following must also be considered:

blocks.zh: Glass delamination（玻璃脫層）——特別是高 pH 配方
blocks.en: Glass delamination, especially for high-pH formulations

blocks.zh: Leachables（可溶出物）——與藥品的交互作用
blocks.en: Leachables and their interaction with the drug product

blocks.zh: Particulate matter（微粒物質）——來源可能是玻璃或瓶塞
blocks.en: Particulate matter, which may originate from the glass or the stopper

blocks.zh: 蛋白質與金屬離子的交互作用——生物製品尤須注意
blocks.en: Interaction of proteins with metal ions, which requires particular attention for biologics

blocks.zh: 凍乾 (lyophilization) 製程對產品品質的影響
blocks.en: The effect of the lyophilization process on product quality

blocks.zh: USP 標準的強制性：文中使用 "must be conducted" 而非 "should"，表示 USP 合規測試是強制性要求，不可省略。關鍵的 USP 章節包括 <381>（彈性體瓶塞）、<660>（玻璃容器）、<1207>（包裝完整性）、<1660>（玻璃內壁耐久性）。
blocks.en: USP standards are mandatory: The text uses "must be conducted" rather than "should", which means USP-compliant testing is a mandatory requirement and cannot be omitted. The key USP chapters include <381> (elastomeric closures), <660> (glass containers), <1207> (package integrity), and <1660> (inner surface durability of glass).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 DMF 責任鏈
blocks.en: Key Notes: The DMF Chain of Responsibility

blocks.zh: DMF Holder 的通知義務：DMF 持有者（通常是 CCS 組件供應商）在做任何 DMF 變更時，必須通知所有受影響的授權方 (authorized parties)。而且這個通知要在變更之前足夠提前發出，讓藥廠有時間提交相應的 supplement。
blocks.en: The DMF holder's notification obligation: A DMF holder (usually the CCS component supplier) must notify all affected authorized parties of any change to the DMF. The notice must also be given sufficiently before the change, so that the drug manufacturer has time to submit the corresponding supplement.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的啟示：作為 CDMO，你不直接持有 NDA/BLA，但你的客戶依賴你的資訊來判斷通報類別。如果你的玻璃瓶供應商通知你變更了製程，你需要及時將此資訊傳達給客戶，讓他們評估是否需要向 FDA 提交 supplement。
blocks.en: Implications for CDMOs: As a CDMO, you do not hold the NDA/BLA directly, but your client relies on your information to determine the reporting category. If your glass vial supplier notifies you of a process change, you need to pass that information to the client promptly so they can assess whether a supplement must be submitted to FDA.

blocks.zh: CDMO 供應商變更管理流程：
blocks.en: CDMO supplier change management process:

blocks.zh: 接收通知：玻璃瓶供應商通知你他們的製造廠址將從 A 廠移至 B 廠
blocks.en: Receive the notification: The glass vial supplier informs you that its manufacturing site will move from Plant A to Plant B

blocks.zh: 初步風險評估：評估變更範圍——僅廠址？還是連製程也變了？
blocks.en: Initial risk assessment: Assess the scope of the change: site only, or has the process changed as well?

blocks.zh: 查表決定通報類別：參考本 Guidance Appendix 表格（Section 3 將詳述）
blocks.en: Look up the reporting category: Refer to the appendix tables of this guidance (covered in detail in Section 3)

blocks.zh: 通知客戶 (Application Holder)：提供變更詳情和建議的通報類別
blocks.en: Notify the client (application holder): Provide the change details and the recommended reporting category

blocks.zh: 準備支持數據：CCIT、穩定性數據、media fill 結果等
blocks.en: Prepare supporting data: CCIT, stability data, media fill results, and so on

blocks.zh: 客戶提交 Supplement：客戶向 FDA 提交相應等級的 supplement
blocks.en: Client submits the supplement: The client submits the supplement of the corresponding level to FDA

blocks.zh: 這個流程與 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 對 CCS 完整性的要求一致——變更管理是污染控制策略 (Contamination Control Strategy) 的一部分。
blocks.en: This process is consistent with the CCS integrity requirements of PIC/S Annex 1 (2022): change management is part of the Contamination Control Strategy.

blocks.zh: 如果你的玻璃瓶供應商同時變更了製造廠址和玻璃組成 (glass composition)，根據 FDA 的原則，你應該選擇哪個通報類別？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your glass vial supplier changes both the manufacturing site and the glass composition, which reporting category should you choose under FDA's principles, and why?

blocks.zh: FDA 提到 "applicants must validate the effects of the change prior to distribution"。在 CDMO 環境中，這個驗證責任如何在客戶和 CDMO 之間分工？
blocks.en: FDA states that "applicants must validate the effects of the change prior to distribution". In a CDMO setting, how is this validation responsibility divided between the client and the CDMO?

blocks.zh: DMF 持有者必須「提前」通知授權方變更資訊。如果 DMF 持有者未及時通知，CDMO/藥廠面臨什麼法規風險？
blocks.en: A DMF holder must notify authorized parties of changes "in advance". If the DMF holder fails to do so in time, what regulatory risks do the CDMO and the drug manufacturer face?

blocks.zh: 比較 FDA 的三級通報系統與 PIC/S Annex 1 (2022) 的變更管理要求，兩者在 CCS 變更管理上有哪些共通原則？
blocks.en: Compare FDA's three-tier reporting system with the change management requirements of PIC/S Annex 1 (2022). What principles do the two share for managing CCS changes?

blocks.zh: 三級通報機制 (Tiered Reporting System)：
blocks.en: Tiered Reporting System:

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Approach (風險導向方法)：FDA 評估 CCS 變更的核心原則是「對產品 identity、strength、quality、purity、potency 的潛在不良影響」。風險越高，通報類別越嚴格。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Approach: The core principle by which FDA assesses CCS changes is the "potential adverse effect on the identity, strength, quality, purity, or potency of the product". The higher the risk, the stricter the reporting category.

blocks.zh: Drug Master File (DMF, 藥物主檔案)：DMF 是 CCS 供應商（如玻璃瓶製造商）向 FDA 提交的機密技術檔案，包含組成、製程、品質控制等資訊。藥廠可在 supplement 中引用 DMF，但仍需提供足夠的產品專屬資訊 (product-specific information)。
blocks.en: Drug Master File (DMF): A DMF is a confidential technical file that a CCS supplier (such as a glass vial manufacturer) submits to FDA, containing information on composition, manufacturing process, quality control, and more. A drug manufacturer may reference the DMF in a supplement but must still provide sufficient product-specific information.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 適用範圍明確：本 Guidance 僅適用於玻璃瓶和瓶塞的 CCS 變更，針對持有 NDA、BLA、ANDA 的無菌注射劑藥品
blocks.en: Clearly defined scope: This guidance applies only to CCS changes for glass vials and stoppers, for sterile injectable drug products with an NDA, BLA, or ANDA

blocks.zh: 風險分級通報：CCS 變更依風險高低分為 PAS（高）、CBE-30（中）、Annual Report（低），通報類別取決於對產品 identity、strength、quality、purity、potency 的潛在影響
blocks.en: Risk-tiered reporting: CCS changes are classified by risk as PAS (high), CBE-30 (moderate), or Annual Report (low); the reporting category depends on the potential effect on the identity, strength, quality, purity, and potency of the product

blocks.zh: ICH 工具整合：FDA 明確建議使用 ICH Q9(R1)（品質風險管理）和 ICH Q12（生命週期管理）的工具來支持降低通報類別的提案
blocks.en: Integration of ICH tools: FDA explicitly recommends using the tools of ICH Q9(R1) (quality risk management) and ICH Q12 (lifecycle management) to support proposals for a lower reporting category

blocks.zh: DMF 責任鏈：DMF 持有者必須提前通知授權方所有變更，藥廠最終負責評估變更對產品品質的影響
blocks.en: DMF chain of responsibility: DMF holders must notify authorized parties of all changes in advance, and the drug manufacturer is ultimately responsible for assessing the effect of the change on product quality

blocks.zh: CCS 相容性是多維度的：評估範圍涵蓋 glass delamination、leachables、particulate matter、蛋白質交互作用及凍乾製程影響，必須符合 USP 藥典標準
blocks.en: CCS compatibility is multidimensional: The assessment covers glass delamination, leachables, particulate matter, protein interactions, and the effect of the lyophilization process, and must comply with USP compendial standards

blocks.zh: COVID-19 遺產：本 Guidance 源自 2021 年疫情緊急指引，反映 FDA 對 CCS 供應鏈韌性的長期關注
blocks.en: The COVID-19 legacy: This guidance originated in the 2021 pandemic emergency guidance and reflects FDA's long-term attention to the resilience of the CCS supply chain
